newsitem.title: MEXICO: FarBen to issue convertible shares.
newsitem.headline: FarBen to issue convertible shares.

text.p: Mexico's FarBen (Bevides) on Tuesday said it would issue convertible Series B shares, worth up to 225 million investment units (UDIs), or about 417.2 million pesos.
FarBen President, Jaime Benavides Pompa, said the issue would be equivalent to 417.2 million pesos, with maturities of up to 66 months and a real interest rate floating between three and six percent.
The drugstore chain said it would use the proceeds to pay down debt, which stands at about 450 million pesos, Benvaides Pompa told reporters at the annual meeting.
